pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately rounded vertices. Dark brown regions on the neck are larger and more elongated, while patches on the flank and lower torso appear smaller and more densely clustered with smoother pixel gradients at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily 3-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the upper neck but exhibits narrowing and increased complexity on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck and shoulder presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the sky. The profile follows a continuous upward curve.

other_distinctive_markers: An avian organism (likely an oxpecker) is visible perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and shoulder.
